question: How can I make a programmatic call?

answers:
To make a programmatic call from a dialog node, you can follow the instructions in the document at this link: <https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/assistant-data?topic=assistant-data-dialog-webhooks>. This document provides information about how to define a webhook, invoke it from a dialog node, and handle errors. However, please note that you can define only one webhook URL for a dialog skill, and the service that you call from the webhook must return a response in 8 seconds or less.
Alternatively, if you want to call a client application from a dialog node, you can add a client action to your dialog node that pauses the dialog so a client-side process can run and return a result as part of the processing that occurs within a dialog turn. This feature was introduced with version 1.4, and you can find more information about it in the document at this link: <https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/assistant-data?topic=assistant-data-dialog-webhooks#client-action>.
In both cases, the programmatic call can be used to validate information, do calculations or string manipulations on user input, or get data from another application or service.

history.content: How do I build a database-driven Slackbot?

To build a database-driven Slackbot, you can follow the tutorial provided in the document at this link: <https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/solution-tutorials?topic=solution-tutorials-slack-chatbot-database-watson>. This tutorial will guide you through the process of building a Slackbot that allows you to search and create entries in a backend Db2 on Cloud database. The Slackbot is backed by the IBM Watson® Assistant service, and you will integrate Slack and IBM Watson® Assistant using an Assistant integration. Db2 on Cloud is made available to Watson Assistant as a custom extension.

Slack is a cloud-based messaging application designed to facilitate collaboration among users. It serves as a platform that enables teams to connect and work together effectively. When you choose Slack as a service destination, any subscribed notifications about events can be sent as messages to specified Slack channels.

To configure the Slack integration for your assistant, follow these steps:
1. Navigate to the Integrations page by clicking the integrations icon in the left menu of your IBM Cloud account.  
2. Click "Add" on the Slack tile.  
3. Click "Confirm."  
4. Ensure that you have a Slack app to connect to. If you don't have one, create it by following the instructions in the "Starting with Slack apps" documentation.  
5. Open the Slack app in a new browser tab to easily switch back and forth between the Slack app settings page and the Watson Assistant Slack integration configuration page.  
6. On the settings page for your Slack app, go to the App Home page.  
7. Add access scopes for your Slack app by clicking the "Review Scopes to Add" or "Update Scopes" button.  
The method for Slack access has changed, so review the necessary scopes based on your app's requirements.

evidence.text:
This action does not make a direct call itself. It basically tells the dialog to pause here and wait for an external client application to go do something. The program that the client application runs can be anything that you choose. Be sure to specify the call name and parameter details, and the error message variable name according to the JSON formatting rules that are outlined later in this topic.

You can call a client application to do the following types of things:



* Validate information that you collected from the user.
* Do calculations or string manipulations on user input that are too complex for supported SpEL expression methods to handle.
* Get data from another application or service.



For information about how to call an external service, such as a Cloud Functions web action, see [Making a programmatic call from a dialog node](https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/assistant-data?topic=assistant-data-dialog-webhooks).

You must provide the call center SIP URI for the call center service you use. You must specify this information in your assistant when you enable a call transfer from a dialog node or action step. For more information, see [Transferring a call to a live agent](https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/watson-assistant?topic=watson-assistant-phone-actionsphone-actions-transfer).





 Optimize your actions for phone interaction 

For the best customer experience, design your dialog with the capabilities of the phone integration in mind:

Can I extend the webhook time limit? 

No. The service that you call from the webhook must return a response in 8 seconds or less, or the call is canceled. You cannot increase this time limit. For more information about strategies for handling complex actions with a webhook, watch the video in [Making a programmatic call from dialog](https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/assistant-data?topic=assistant-data-dialog-webhooks).
